text:
The open-door notes were John Hay's 1899–1900 diplomatic notes asking the great powers to respect equal trading access in China. Of the two options, the first, an American proclamation that China should be open to US trade and missionaries, is the closer match, though the notes themselves dealt with trade access rather than missionaries. My earlier answer was wrong to say I didn't know, since this is a well-documented piece of US history.

CONFIDENCE: 60
